column3: Please confirm your flight details before you leave. (出發前請確認您的航班資訊。)
We need to discuss the project plan tomorrow. (我們明天需要討論專案計畫。)
I cannot access my email account right now. (我現在無法登入我的電子郵件帳號。)
Please inform the manager if you are late. (如果你會遲到，請通知經理。)
She successfully finished the presentation on time. (她成功地準時完成了簡報。)
Please secure your seatbelt before the plane takes off. (飛機起飛前請繫好您的安全帶。)
I like to buy fresh fruit at the local market. (我喜歡在當地的市場買新鮮水果。)
The police will investigate the cause of the accident. (警方將調查事故的原因。)
Many companies compete for the same customers. (許多公司為了爭取相同的客戶而競爭。)
The team celebrated their victory after the final game. (球隊在最後一場比賽後慶祝他們的勝利。)
